title: Graph snapshot drift detection and graceful fallback protocol for multi-stream decode
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: We occasionally see nondeterministic failures during CUDA graph capture or replay when multiple decode streams interleave prefill and decode kernels. Failures manifest as wrong KV cache states, OOMs in certain stream mixes, or silent token drift after replay. Root cause signals point to (a) partial capture where stream quiescence was assumed but outstanding async kernels attached to the same CU remained, and (b) kernel selection shifts between capture and replay on heterogeneous batch shapes. Goals: 1) Implement a lightweight runtime detector that computes a compact snapshot fingerprint at capture boundary (hash of critical allocator epochs, KV cache shape summary, and selected kernel IDs) and verifies equivalence before replay. 2) If drift is detected, perform an automated graceful fallback: re-run in eager path for the affected streams and mark the capture as contaminated; record telemetry, surface to ops dashboard, and increment a per-model mitigation counter. 3) Add unit and system-level fuzz tests that reproduce drift classes and a CI gate that prevents merges which increase drift rate. Non-goals: redesigning the entire kernel scheduler or replacing CUDA graphs with an alternative capture mechanism in this ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime emits a 128-bit capture fingerprint at each CUDA graph capture boundary and persists it to the capture metadata store.
Before each replay, fingerprint comparison is performed; if mismatch is detected the runtime falls back to the eager execution path for the affected stream(s) without failing the client request.
Telemetry counters exist for: capture_fingerprint_mismatch, fallback_count, fallback_latency_p99, and fallback_token_drift_rate.
End-to-end fuzz harness reproduces at least three previously observed drift cases in CI and regression tests fail if drift reappears.
A canary rollout (10% of dedicated nodes) with fingerprinting enabled shows <0.5% increase in average latency and reduces silent-token-drift incidents to 0 for canary traffic over 48h.
Documentation and runbook updated with diagnostic commands and recommended triage steps.
implementation_notes: Add CaptureFingerprint struct: fields = capture_timestamp, allocator_epoch, kv_cache_summary (shape+hash), kernel_selection_ids, sequence_epoch_id.
Hook fingerprint generation at capture commit; store alongside cuda-graph binary metadata in the capture registry.
During replay, compute runtime fingerprint and compare to stored value. Use Hamming distance thresholding for kernel_selection_ids to allow tolerated minor reordering (configurable).
If mismatch: mark capture as contaminated, route affected request(s) to eager kernel path and schedule background re-capture candidate with tightened quiesce barriers.
Extend kernel selection logic to emit deterministic stable IDs used in fingerprinting; put a compatibility layer to map older captures.
Instrument trace spans around capture/replay to include fingerprint fields for debug and SLO correlation.
Add a configurable boolean 'capture_strict_mode' that, when true in canary, treats mismatches as fatal and forces immediate alerting for rapid root-cause discovery.
Implement background re-replay test that validates re-capture binary produces identical fingerprint under synthetic load before replacing contaminated capture in registry.
Ensure KV cache migration code understands epoched snapshots and can rollback partial writes encountered during mixed-mode fallbacks.
testing_plan: Unit tests for CaptureFingerprint canonicalization and hash stability across endianness and different GPU architectures.
Deterministic integration test: spawn 8 decode streams with interleaved prefill patterns and assert fingerprint equality on a golden capture run.
Fuzz harness that randomly injects delayed CUDA events, stream preemption, and kernel-choice jitter to reproduce historical failures; assert fallback triggers and no silent drift remains.
Performance microbench to measure fallback latency and p99 regression when fallback is exercised; include in nightly perf job.
Chaos test: simulate partial failed re-capture and assert runtime falls back gracefully and capture registry remains consistent.
CI gating: require that new changes do not increase fingerprint mismatch rate for baseline model-suite by >0.1%.
Manual Playbook: steps for running diagnostics on a live node, including commands for dumping capture fingerprint, listing contaminated captures, and forcing re-capture.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (internal): Merge behind feature flag; run on internal dev clusters for 1 week with synthetic load.
Phase 1 (canary): Enable on 10% of dedicated nodes and 1% of hosted region traffic. Monitor fallback_count, p99 latency, and token-drift alerts for 48h.
Phase 2 (ramped): If canary stable, gradually increase to 50% over 72h while keeping capture_strict_mode=false.
Phase 3 (global): Enable across fleet and turn on strict-mode for a short window (1h) to detect any remaining latent mismatches, then revert to non-fatal fallback.
Rollback criteria: sustained fallback_count causing >1% error budget burn in 1h or p99 latency spike >20% relative to baseline.
risks: Fingerprint computation may add measurable overhead to capture if naive; mitigate by making summaries compact and sampling when under extreme load.
False positives: overly-sensitive fingerprinting might cause unnecessary fallbacks increasing latency; mitigate via thresholding and whitelist for small, benign kernel reorderings.
Compatibility: older captures lacking kernel IDs need a mapping layer; failure to map could cause repeated fallbacks until re-captured.
Operational burden: new telemetry and contaminated-capture churn could flood SRE alerts if rollout not throttled.
Edge case: a fallback to eager path could hide a latent correctness bug in kernel selection that only surfaces under high concurrency; include targeted stress suites.
metrics: fallback_count: counter and rate by model, by region
fallback_latency_p50_p95_p99: histograms for end-to-end request latency when fallback triggers
contaminated_capture_cleanup_time: time from detection to re-capture replacement
silent_token_drift_rate: regression metric comparing golden-run tokens to production tokens post-replay
